object: bank of four sheet-steel personnel lockers on short legs
understanding: Thin folded sheet throughout: doors dent and bow, the carcass racks out of square, the top caves if something lands on it. Folded edges and the door frames are the stiff lines.
Hurt by kicks and fists at door height, things thrown against it, and being knocked over or leaned into by heavy kit.
Rust starts at the feet and bottom edge, round vents, handles and number plates, and along every dent crease. Paint wears at door edges.
